text:
marta: short report from q4 bring-up: ndcg@10 +0.9% but mrr@10 -1.8%. Hit is focused on very short queries (<6 tokens).
omar: paste eval command and any candidate normalizations?
marta: eval: ./eval_harness --model rerank-q4 --holdout release_v3 --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@10 --slice length:bins=[0,6,40,inf] --candidate_norm=div_len --seed=101
kevin: suspect numeric fastpath difference (eps/clamp) in quant runtime affecting tiny denominators -> softmax flips.
sree: also check tokenization / html stripping; short queries are brittle.
marta: found diff: fp32 uses score_norm = score / (len_tokens + 1e-12) but q4 fastpath used +1e-5. that explains len<=3 skew.
omar: align epsilons; also compute pairwise top1 agreement with fp32.
marta: local 1k short sample: fp32 gold=1000; q4(orig)=957 match; q4(eps-aligned)=991 match; q4(temp=1.2 short)=986 match.
kevin: plan: push epsilon fix, add unit tests for len in {1,2,3}, add per-slice temp fallback in runtime config for mitigation, add short-query slice to release checklist.
ci-bot: full eval queued: rerank-releasev3-q4-3421000000 (ETA ~4h).
sree: if full eval short mrr still >1% down, block canary and enable per-slice temp on dedicated pool. else proceed.
marta: opening PR with fix + tests + bake plan. will attach sample swap cases for review. Thanks all :thumbsup:
